name: 霜之哀伤
description: 对本棋子1格内1个敌方棋子造成2倍伤害。若击杀目标，获得1点充能点。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 1, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var player = battle.players.find(function(item) { return item.playerId === caster.ownerPlayerId; }); var chargeBefore = player ? (player.chargePoints || 0) : 0; var damage = Math.floor(caster.attack * context.skill.powerMultiplier); var result = dealDamage(caster, target, damage, 'physical', battle, context.skill.id); var message = caster.name + '用霜之哀伤斩击' + target.name + '，造成' + result.damage + '点物理伤害'; if (result.isKilled && player && !target.noKillCharge) { player.chargePoints = chargeBefore + 1; message += '，并额外获得1点充能'; } return { success: true, message: message }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { var dmg = Math.floor(piece.attack * skillDef.powerMultiplier); return { description: "对本棋子1格内1个敌方棋子造成2倍伤害。若击杀目标，获得1点充能点。", expectedValues: { damage: dmg } }; }
